outputs.explanation: Panel A shows single percentage values (illumination overhead) for each exposure-time condition as a bar/timeline diagram; these are not averaged/summary statistics over replicates, so individual data points are not applicable.
Line plot with shaded mean±s.e.m. error regions; line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement as overlaying points would make them unreadable.
Scatter plot showing mean±s.e.m. per condition where each plotted point already represents a data point; scatter plots are exempt from this check.
Panel shows individual cell migration tracks (each line is a single cell's path), not an averaged summary statistic, so overlaying additional individual points is not applicable.
Bar chart of mean±s.e.m. migration speed per condition has individual data points (dots for each analyzed cell) overlaid on the bars.
Panel F consists of fluorescence micrographs (MitoTracker, Paxillin, Merge), not a plot of averaged data.
Panel G is a time series of micrographs (Paxillin and Mitotracker channels), not a plot of averaged data.
Panel H is a time series of micrographs (Paxillin and Mitotracker channels), not a plot of averaged data.
Line plot of normalized cell area (mean±s.e.m.) over time; line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Line plot of normalized mitochondrial area (mean±s.e.m.) over time; line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
